name: Kami-sama, Saigo ni Mou Ichido
source:
The happiness of being able to say goodbye to the one you love.

"Let's say goodbye. 
Smiling, with no regrets left."

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17546]Freem![/url]]
translation:
能够与所爱之人告别的幸福。

“我们说再见吧。
微笑着，不留遗憾。”

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17546]Freem![/url]]
